title: Gen-2 Modification/Causal Ledger Record
description: One append-only record per Ledger edge G0->G1. Spec: scratch/gen2_qualification_skeleton_A.md §5.2 + scratch/gen2_qualification_skeleton_A.json modification_causal_ledger + scratch/gen2_parent_integration_v0.1.md §7. File: manifests/gen2_modification_ledger.jsonl (JSONL, comment lines starting with # are header). Invariants: append-only, write-once, evidence_state SPECIFIED->IMPLEMENTED->TESTED->OBSERVED, reason_before_results precedes observed.

change_id.description: Unique Ledger edge ID, e.g. GEN2_C000 scaffold, GEN2_C001 etc. Write-once.

kind.description: Optional discriminator; absent means ledger_entry. b12_extension records are companion records after B12.

config_hash.description: Gen-1 or prior Gen-2 config_hash (immutable reference 4f9fdeae7428199a for C000)

hp_hash.description: HDP hp_hash (full f327f9d2ad64cc88 or prefix f327f9d2 at C000)

rf_hash.description: RFConfig.hash() if RF present, else null

parameter_path.description: Dotted path to changed parameter, e.g. network.builder.within_gain or 'scaffold' for C000

pathway.description: Mechanistic pathway, e.g. H->b_eff, E/I, RF retinotopy, ledger.init

old_value.description: Value before change (same hash/value for scaffold C000)

reason_before_results.description: Why change was proposed BEFORE results observed (temporal invariant; violation = B11 FAIL)

qualification_target.description: Which Bk gap this change targets, e.g. B0 provenance audit or scaffold

predicted_generic_effect.description: Predicted generic biophysical effect (string or dict) — never T1-T7

observed_generic_effect.description: Measured generic effect after test (string/dict or null before TESTED)

gate.description: Gate this change is sealed under

b12_extension.description: Post-B12 extension appended without mutating pre-B12 line (via extend_ledger_after_B12). Only after B11 freeze.
